scientific_integrity: The commutator kernel and its positivity and first trace are explicitly attributed to Frank--Ivanisvili. The new assertions concern the squared Hilbert--Schmidt norm, its completely monotone Laplace representation, two scale limits and the resulting effective-rank law. Finite diagnostics do not replace the integral proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the Hilbert--Schmidt trace-square and its scale profile are determined; no individual eigenvalue asymptotics or full singular-value distribution are asserted.
Positivity and trace pi/2 are taken from the cited 2026 result only in the established s>=1 range; no positivity claim is made at smaller scales.
The novelty comparison is bounded by the inspected sources and published records; related semiclassical trace identities may independently imply part of the large-scale asymptotics.
title: Complete-monotonic trace-square law for arctangent commutators
